tier_error_bands.definition: Construction errors are evaluated against JANAF liquid Gibbs tables at Tfus and offsets +300/+800 K; rows without a liquid reference point beyond the published table limit are omitted at that offset. Tier 1 is an in-sample control and tier 2 uses leave-one-out family estimates. Tier 3 fusion entropy is restricted to measured class-C pairs under d-071 criterion 2; d-070 requires calibrating the systematic rule and its uncertainty on real data. Tier-3 construction remains available for targets without their own measurement under d-071 criterion 4.
tier_error_bands.units: kJ mol^-1; dex per metal atom

census_summary.criterion: d-071 criterion 2 and d-070 systematic-estimate calibration; d-071 criterion 4 permits targets without their own measurement

ladder.source: 1013 K is the lower endpoint of the NASA Glenn CEA K2O(l) interval, based on Gurvich et al. (1982), TPIS Vol. IV, pt. 1, p. 377 and pt. 2, p. 406; the same value appears in the TKV database (Gurvich lineage, no further bibliography). The alkali M2O melting-point series supports this selection: Li2O 1711 K (Ortman and Larsen), Na2O 1405.2 K (NIST-JANAF/DTA), and Rb2O 778 K and Cs2O 763–768 K (Gurvich).
